full_text: Hello. Hello. Kahan se ho aap? Kanpur, UP se. Kya karte ho aap? Hum to job karte hain. Tum kahan se ho? Main Delhi se. Kya karte ho? Maine abhi graduation ki hai. Graduation kari hai. Aur batao. Kya ho raha hai? Kuch nahi, bas app chala rahi thi, ispe time pass karne aayi thi app pe. Okay, same here. So, socho thodi bakchodi hi kar li jaye. Woh koi aur dhundo uske liye.
